data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value: • Text (Title Caption):Defines the header string displayed along the application’s top window bar. • BackColor & ForeColor:BackColor defines the background canvas color fill of the container. • BackgroundImage & Layout:Renders custom graphic assets directly across the form surface. • FormBorderStyle:Governs the border frame style (FixedSingle, Sizable, None). • StartPosition & Opacity:StartPosition sets where the window spawns on boot (e.g., CenterScreen).

data.name: RichTextBox2.Text
data.value:
Size / ClientSize: Sets the overall width and height.
MaximizeBox: Shows or hides the Maximize button.
MinimizeBox: Shows or hides the Minimize button.
AcceptButton: The button automatically clicked when pressing Enter.
